draft.aboutParagraph: With over 18 years in residential and commercial real estate and a lifetime of community engagement, Cindy Carlson combines market expertise with genuine care. sections.title: North Idaho’s Silver Valley
sections.body: Nestled in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains, in the heart of the Panhandle National Forest, the Silver Valley is most noted for its mining heritage, dating back to the 1880s. The Silver Valley is also famous for it’s Ski Resorts ~ Silver Mountain and Lookout Pass; it’s Bike Trails, ATV Trails and The World’s Longest Gondola. The narrow valley, about 40 miles in length, comprises a number of small towns along the South Fork of the Coeur d’Alene River and Interstate 90.

With deep roots to this area, Cindy and her husband Denny, have raised their family and enjoyed this scenic area for over 40 years. My team and I are here to guide you—whether your path leads to land, recreational properties, business opportunities, or a place to call home. With four Realtor® designations and active engagement in our local boards and organizations, I bring a depth of knowledge to every client and every transaction. Your goals are my highest priority, and this commitment is reflected in everything I do for buyers and sellers alike.

Welcome To Cindy Carlson Realty
Cindy Carlson Realty A Full Service Real Estate Agency located in Kellogg Idaho.
THE AREA
North Idaho’s Silver Valley
Nestled in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains, in the heart of the Panhandle National Forest, the Silver Valley is most noted for its mining heritage, dating back to the 1880s. The Silver Valley is also famous for it’s Ski Resorts ~ Silver Mountain and Lookout Pass; it’s Bike Trails, ATV Trails and The World’s Longest Gondola. The narrow valley, about 40 miles in length, comprises a number of small towns along the South Fork of the Coeur d’Alene River and Interstate 90.
ABOUT
Cindy Carlson, Broker, Realtor ® , ABR, CRS, GRI, RSPS, RPAC Major Investor
Cindy Carlson, Broker/owner of Cindy Carlson Realty, located in Kellogg, Idaho, is a 18 year residential/commercial real estate veteran. With deep roots to this area, Cindy and her husband Denny, have raised their family and enjoyed this scenic area for over 40 years. After 25+ years as a well known figure at a local dentist office, she decided to take her personal skills and stellar work ethic and turn it into a real estate career.
